item.title: The Amir congratulates Lebanon's president on Independence Day
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani today, Sunday, sent a cable of congratulations to Lebanese President General Joseph Aoun on his country's Independence Day. His Highness the Deputy Amir sent a similar cable, and the Prime Minister congratulated his Lebanese counterpart on the occasion.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D9%87%D9%86%D8%A6-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%86-1 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/amir-sends-congratulations-to-president-of-lebanon-1 · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738737/qatar/hh-the-amir-sends-congratulations-to-president-of-lebanon · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/prime-minister-sends-congratulations-to-lebanese-counterpart

item.title: Al Rayyan go clear at QSL summit with 5-3 win
item.description:
Al Rayyan went clear at the top of the Qatar Stars League on Saturday evening with a 5-3 win over Al Shahania to close round 10, moving to 24 points, three ahead of second-placed Al Sadd. Serbian striker Aleksandar Mitrovic scored a hat-trick and Brazilian Gabriel Pereira a brace, while Al Sadd returned to winning ways with a 3-2 victory over Lusail. The round produced 28 goals in six matches.

item.title: Doha Bank wins two Global Finance awards for banking transformation
item.description:
Doha Bank won Global Finance's awards for Best CEO in Transformation in the banking sector for 2026 and Best Strategic Transformation Initiative in the banking sector for 2026. The bank attributed the awards to its digital innovation, customer experience and operational excellence initiatives led by Group CEO Sheikh Abdulrahman bin Fahad bin Faisal Al Thani.

item.title: QRCS scientific conference closes after 62 sessions and 16 panels
item.description:
Qatar Red Crescent Society on Saturday concluded its 4th Annual Scientific Conference on respiratory, allergy and immunology diseases in primary health care, after three days of 62 sessions and 16 panel discussions with 61 speakers and 53 moderators. The conference was held under the patronage of Minister of Public Health Mansoor bin Ebrahim Al Mahmoud, in partnership with the ministry, Hamad Medical Corporation and the Primary Health Care Corporation.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/62-%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%A9-%D9%8816-%D8%AD%D9%84%D9%82%D8%A9-%D9%86%D9%82%D8%A7%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AE%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%A4%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1%D9%8A · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/22/qrcss-4th-annual-scientific-conference-concludes-discussing-respiratory-allergy-immunology-diseases

item.title: UDST honours 67 high-achieving students
item.description:
The University of Doha for Science and Technology honoured 67 students at its annual Academic Awards Ceremony, presenting 68 awards across ten categories, including academic excellence, applied research, innovation and graduate thesis impact.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738739/community/education/udst-celebrates-academic-excellence-at-annual-awards · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/udst-honours-67-students-for-academic-excellence-and-innovation

item.title: UAE condemns Iranian attack that set fire to an industrial site in Bahrain
item.description:
The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs today, Sunday, condemned in the strongest terms a renewed Iranian attack on Bahrain, calling it a flagrant violation of the kingdom's sovereignty. Saturday night's attack hit a civilian industrial facility and started a fire that Civil Defence brought under control with no injuries, according to Bahrain's Interior Ministry. Jordan also condemned the attack, while the Bahrain Defence Force said it intercepted several projectiles.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/uae-condemns-iranian-attack-on-bahrain-after-fire-breaks-out-at-industrial-facility-1.500756853 · Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-22-1.2105328 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/bahrain-says-iranian-attack-causes-fire-at-industrial-facility · Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200037/world/region/bahrain-comes-under-fresh-iranian-attack · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662

item.title: Gargash warns of a geopolitical contest running parallel to the Iran war
item.description:
UAE presidential diplomatic adviser Anwar Gargash today, Sunday, warned that a geopolitical contest no less dangerous than the war with Iran is taking shape alongside it, with repercussions for Gulf states and the Arab world. Writing on X, he said the use of media and financial tools is "the tip of the iceberg" of a wider struggle for influence, and that divergent GCC positions and the absence of a unified Gulf stance complicate the picture.
Sources: Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-22-1.2105326 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662

item.title: Dubai Metro Blue Line reaches 30% completion
item.description:
Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, reviewed progress on the Dubai Metro Blue Line at Dubai Festival City, with the project now about 30% complete. The Dh14.5 billion project employs 14,000 workers, engineers and supervisors who have logged 33 million working hours ahead of its scheduled opening on 9 September 2029.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/dubai/sheikh-hamdan-reviews-dubai-metro-blue-line-progress-as-project-nears-30-completion-1.500756801 · Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-22-1.2105322

item.title: UAE makes online platforms liable for third-party goods
item.description:
UAE Cabinet Decision No. 166 of 2026 extends the liability of e-commerce platforms to goods and services offered or sold by third-party suppliers through their websites and applications. The amendment to consumer protection rules prevents platforms from rejecting complaints on the grounds that a purchase was made from an independent seller.
Sources: Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/business/local/2026-11-22-1.2105267 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/bought-something-online-in-the-uae-who-is-responsible-if-things-go-wrong-1.500756834

item.title: Oman sets National Day holiday for 25 and 26 November
item.description:
Oman's Ministry of Labour announced that the 2026 National Day holiday will fall on Wednesday and Thursday, 25 and 26 November. The dates were set in advance on 28 December 2025 under a government policy of announcing national and religious holidays at the start of each Gregorian year, except Eid Al-Fitr and Eid Al-Adha.
Sources: Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179437-its-official-national-day-holiday-announced-in-oman · Oman Observer https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200045/oman/community/no-guessing-this-time-as-holidays-known-in-advance

item.title: Omani five-aircraft air bridge carries relief to Nepal
item.description:
The Oman Charitable Organisation, in coordination with the Oman Red Crescent, dispatched a five-aircraft air bridge carrying humanitarian and relief aid to Nepal. The cargo includes essential food supplies, tents, blankets, generators and cooking and lighting equipment for people affected by natural disasters.
Sources: Oman Observer (ONA) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200044/oman/oman-dispatches-humanitarian-aid-to-nepal · Times of Oman https://timesofoman.com/article/179440-oman-red-crescent-operates-air-bridge-using-various-aircraft-to-nepal

item.title: Dollar climbs above EGP 54 at Egyptian banks
item.description:
The dollar rose above EGP 54 for selling at Egyptian banks during trading today, Sunday, after holding at EGP 53.87 in the morning. It reached EGP 54.40 for buying and EGP 54.50 for selling at the National Bank of Egypt and Banque du Caire, up 64 piastres, and EGP 54.10 for selling at Banque Misr, up 23 piastres.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news-banking/details/2026/11/22/3082469 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7189765 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news-banking/details/2026/11/22/3082457

item.title: Egyptian bourse opens week with broad losses as EGX30 drops 2.3%
item.description:
The Egyptian Exchange opened today, Sunday, with broad losses across its indices, tracking the slide in global markets, and market capitalisation shed about EGP 94.3 billion in the first minutes. The benchmark EGX30 fell 2.35% to 50,250 points and the EGX70 dropped 3.92% to 16,819, while the exchange suspended trading in 12 shares for 10 minutes.
Sources: Cairo24 https://www.cairo24.com/2533627 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627704

item.title: Gold rises in Egypt, with 21-carat at EGP 5,510
item.description:
Gold rose by about EGP 40 in Egypt during trading today, Sunday, with the widely traded 21-carat at EGP 5,510 per gram and 24-carat at about EGP 6,297. The rise follows a drop of more than 8.4% in 21-carat last week, when it fell to a one-year low of EGP 5,445, according to the Federation of Egyptian Industries' gold division.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/22/3082456 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7189695 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627652 · Cairo24 https://www.cairo24.com/2533615

item.title: Investment minister discusses wider trade with Iraq's ambassador
item.description:
Investment and Foreign Trade Minister Mohamed Farid today, Sunday, discussed strengthening investment and trade ties with Iraq's Ambassador in Cairo Qahtan Taha Khalaf, in preparation for the Egyptian-Iraqi joint committee. The meeting covered greater access for Egyptian products to the Iraqi market and the participation of Egyptian companies in construction and reconstruction projects.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627707 · Cairo24 https://www.cairo24.com/2533630

item.title: Four tax office employees in Gharbia referred to urgent trial
item.description:
The Administrative Prosecution referred four employees of a public tax office in Gharbia governorate to urgent disciplinary trial on charges of serious financial and administrative violations that harmed the state treasury. The accused are two tax officers and two tax auditors.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627699 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_cases/details/2026/11/22/3082462

item.title: Egypt U-17 face Qatar today seeking first win
item.description:
Egypt's U-17 side meet Qatar this evening, Sunday, at the Aspire Academy in Doha to close the second round of Group A at the U-17 World Cup. Hussein Abdel Latif's team seek a first win after losing to Greece, while Qatar come into the match after a 2-0 win over Panama.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627675 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/qatar-chase-winning-streak-saudi-arabia-seek-redemption-at-fifa-u-17-world-cup

item.title: COP31 enters second day of overtime with draft omitting fossil fuels
item.description:
The COP31 presidency in Antalya today, Sunday, released a new draft deal two days after the scheduled close, acknowledging for the first time that warming is on course to pass 1.5C but omitting any mention of fossil fuels. Conference President Murat Kurum said the text could win consensus, while Saudi Arabia and other major producers pushed to keep fossil fuels out; the draft needs the approval of nearly 200 nations.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (Reuters, AP) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/fossil-fuel-impasse-pushes-cop31-climate-talks-into-second-day-of-overtime · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/fossil-fuels-still-missing-from-latest-cop31-draft-deal-1.500755945

item.title: Eleven killed in clashes during capture of Mexican cartel boss
item.description:
Seven suspected cartel gunmen and four Mexican soldiers were killed in the operation to arrest cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores in Guasave, Sinaloa state. The United States had offered a $5 million reward for information leading to his arrest, while President Claudia Sheinbaum faces US pressure to intensify the crackdown on cartels.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (AP) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/eleven-killed-in-burst-of-violence-during-mexican-cartel-leaders-capture · News of Bahrain (Reuters) https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/11-killed-after-mexico-captures-cartel-boss

item.title: Three dead, 36 missing in Indonesia confectionery factory fire
item.description:
Rescuers in Indonesia today, Sunday, are searching for 36 missing workers after a fire broke out on Saturday evening at a confectionery factory in Serang regency, west of Jakarta, killing three people and injuring four. Fires were still burning in parts of the factory, complicating the search.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/three-dead-36-missing-after-indonesia-factory-fire-1.500756681 · Emarat Al Youm (Reuters) https://www.emaratalyoum.com/politics/news/2026-11-22-1.2105318

item.title: Russian drone destroys apartment block in Kyiv region
item.description:
A Russian drone overnight into Sunday destroyed a five-storey apartment building in Dymer, Kyiv region, injuring a teenager and a woman, with up to seven people feared trapped under the rubble. Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 186 drones from Saturday evening, of which 161 were downed.
Sources: Kyiv Post https://www.kyivpost.com/post/90829 · Ukrinform https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187306-drone-attack-damages-apartment-block-in-kyiv-region-people-may-be-trapped-under-rubble.html · Ukrinform https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4187288-air-defenses-down-161-of-186-russian-drones-launched-against-ukraine-since-evening.html

item.title: Verstappen wins the Las Vegas Grand Prix
item.description:
Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix, finishing 0.639 seconds ahead of Lando Norris, with McLaren teammate Oscar Piastri third. World champion Kimi Antonelli of Mercedes dropped to fourth after a problem in the closing metres, and Verstappen extended his lead in the fight for runner-up to 37 points.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/11/22/max-verstappen-las-vegas-grand-prix-f1-norris-piastri-russell-antonelli · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D9%88%D9%84%D9%86%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%83%D8%B3-%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%A8%D9%86-%D9%8A%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B2-%D8%A8%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%BA%D8%A7%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%89-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-1
